member.name: SpeechDenoiser
member.para: What it is for, measured. On "De vandrande djäknarne" the chapter 1 announcement is a coin flip for ggml-small, recovered by only 10 of 22 window framings 20 ms apart - the same audio coming back as "1. Kapitlet – Gjäknupptåg", "1. KAPITLET", "1. KAPITLÄT", "1. KJÄKNUGTÅG" or "1. Jäknuktåg" depending on where the window opened, at p=0.45-0.65 throughout. Denoised first, every one of the 22 reads "1. Kapitlet". The alternative that works equally well is a bigger model (medium and large-v3-turbo), at 2-3x the decode cost of a denoise plus a re-read.

Why only the denoiser is bundled. LavaSR's bandwidth extension reconstructs content above the merge cutoff, Whisper resamples to 16 kHz and hears nothing above 8 kHz, and denoise-only was measured to give the identical 22 of 22 at better than twice the speed.
